Position: DS/AI Engineer

Engagement Mode: On-site
Location: Gurugram

Position Overview

DS AI team is seeking a DS/AI Engineer to accelerate chatbot and GenAI development with a focus on rapid deployment, enterprise use-cases, and scalable production systems. The role involves building RAG-based chatbot systems, integrating enterprise data, and deploying scalable GenAI solutions. The engineer will work directly with the DS Lead in a high-ownership environment with fast execution cycles and will be responsible for the full lifecycle of GenAI solutions from prototyping to production deployment. Only candidates with real GenAI/chatbot development experience will be considered.

Key Responsibilities

Develop RAG-based chatbot solutions

Prototype and deploy use cases rapidly

Build retrieval pipelines

Develop backend APIs

Implement prompt engineering and evaluation

Ensure monitoring and continuous improvements

Deliver production chatbot systems

Implement RAG pipeline end-to-end

Build and maintain API services

Develop evaluation and prompt frameworks

Handle deployment and documentation

Required Skills

Python

LLMs (OpenAI/Azure)

RAG pipelines

Vector DB/Search systems

FastAPI

Prompt engineering

Production deployment

2 5 years of experience with chatbot/GenAI solutions

Preferred (Bonus) Skills

LangChain / LangGraph

CrewAI and/or AutoGen

Multimodal AI

Enterprise AI experience
